name: Mazatlán, Mexico

visa.notes: Temporary resident visa requires ~$1,500/mo income or ~$25,000 savings.

rent.notes: Trovit annual-rental 3BR houses in Mazatlan fraccionamientos (Real del Valle, Palmilla, Azul Pacifico, Almar etc.) list MXN 12,000-40,000 with median ~MXN 20,000 (~USD 1,070); Live and Invest Overseas: 3BR USD 659 outside centre / 1,200 centre, 2BR budget USD 1,100. Numbeo Mazatlan (2024) 3BR MXN 14,700-18,700. Converted at ~18.75 MXN/USD (Banxico FIX 18.79 on 30 Oct 2026).

healthcare.notes: IMSS Modalidad 33 voluntary enrollment for age 60-69 is MXN 20,600/yr per person from 1 Mar 2026 (~USD 92/mo, ~USD 183/mo for two); this is the min. Typical adds a basic private Mexican plan for one person (brokers quote ~USD 120-300/mo per person at 60 for Mexican-insurer plans, USD 320-500 for broader cover); max is two basic-to-mid private plans. Converted at ~18.75 MXN/USD (Banxico FIX 18.79 on 30 Oct 2026).
